hint: When there are **two middle values**, the median is the average of those two.
explanation: Even number of values ($4$) → two middle values: $8$ and $11$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why average the middle two?
steps: The median should split the data so half is below and half is above.
With $4$ numbers, no single value splits them evenly — but the **midpoint between the middle two** does.

hints.text: When there are **two middle values**, the median is the average of those two.
